mechanism.claim: At the fixed UTC day boundary, a one-standard-deviation daily acceleration in normalized aggressive BTC/USDT taker flow during an unusually volatile BTC day identifies a fresh migration of directional liquidity rather than a persistent crowded level. The flow-acceleration direction should relay for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: sign of the completed daily change in normalized BTCUSDT taker flow
mechanism.why_distinct: DTFAR trades the first difference of daily dominant-book normalized flow. DAFSR and DAFCAR conditioned on the flow level's sign relationship with price; DSQFCR used cross-denominator same-day consensus; intrahour flow candidates used dense BTC activity clocks.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed-day realized variation must be in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one 00:05 UTC daily flow-acceleration clock is absent from Gross9

features.flow_change: current completed-day normalized flow minus immediately prior completed-day normalized flow, nonzero
features.flow_change_z: standardized against at most 90 strictly prior finite changes, minimum 60, current excluded; prior sample std positive
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum of 24 squared completed-hour BTC log returns)
features.volatility_rank: strict-prior midrank against at most 90 valid days, minimum 60; current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: exact D 00:00 UTC after every source feature is available
clock.reservation: fixed daily decisions; global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.price_direction_oi_funding_implied_vol: not signal inputs; exact funding only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.flow: hash-bound Binance stablecoin quote-flow panel through 2026-07-31
source_plan.completed_price: hash-bound completed-hour BTC through 2026-08-01 for pre-entry variation only
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, side, hold, clock, or subset repair.
